_comment: FAKE DATA for testing only. All coordinates are PLACEHOLDERS near DCU Glasnevin (about [-6.257, 53.385]); they are not surveyed. Report fields follow the backend (type, title, description, category, location.coordinates as [longitude, latitude], eventDate with timezone). 'key' is a local label used by test-matching.ts and is not stored. 'truePairs' lists the reports that SHOULD match; every other report is a decoy. Decoys D5/D11 are similar black earbud items in different places.
